declaration.candidate_semantics: Every candidate keeps v28's share (0.75), residual stage, LIRF blends, outer weight 0.7 and floor; only the committee mix's network table changes. d_all48 = the plain mean of all 48 context seeds; d_half32 = v28's pool with its e24 half doubled to 32 seeds; d_e24x32 = the 32 e24 seeds alone.

control.recipe: v28 = configs/adsb_ctx_v2.json pool_s75 (committee mix network 0.5 ens_ctx + 0.5 ens_ctx_e24 at share 0.75; v25's LIRF blends)
control.reproduction: the control must reproduce these (pool_s75's round-A development RMSE) to 1e-9 s on every recipe month before any candidate is read

execution.network_hosts: Azure arcw0-arcw7 as their round-B lanes finish (worker arcwN: seeds 133+N lane A, 141+N lane B), 8 threads, tools/ctx_chain.sh configs/adsb_ctx_network_v2.json ctx_e24 <seed> runs/adsb_ctx seasonal forward refit refit12 (launcher tools/ctx_launch_dev3.sh)

external_data: adsb.lol globe_history (ODbL) via the committee's ADS-B tables and match tables
IEM weather and OurAirports runways via the timeline bundle

ens_ctx.ensemble: ens_ctx = per-fold seed mean over the 16 learners (tools/ensemble_adsb_full.py convention), every leaf checked against the declared variant, code, configuration and seed
ens_ctx.folds: seasonal (predicts 2025-01/07), forward (2025-11), refit (Jan-Nov; December leaf cache runs/december/learners/runs__adsb_ctx__ctx_s<seed>.parquet, ranking), refit12 (Jan-Dec; ranking), run in that order per seed by tools/ctx_chain.sh
ens_ctx.status: fitted and scored under adsb_ctx_v1 (its ensemble directory and December leaves unchanged)

ens_ctx_e24.ensemble: ens_ctx_e24 = per-fold seed mean over its 16 learners (tools/ensemble_adsb_full.py); December from the learners' January-November refit leaves
ens_ctx_e24.folds: seasonal (predicts 2025-01/07), forward (2025-11), refit (Jan-Nov; December leaf cache runs/december/learners/runs__adsb_ctx__ctx_s<seed>.parquet, ranking), refit12 (Jan-Dec; ranking), run in that order per seed by tools/ctx_chain.sh

ens_ctx_e24b.ensemble: ens_ctx_e24b = per-fold seed mean over its 16 learners (tools/ensemble_adsb_full.py); December from the learners' January-November refit leaves
ens_ctx_e24b.folds: seasonal (predicts 2025-01/07), forward (2025-11), refit (Jan-Nov; December leaf cache runs/december/learners/runs__adsb_ctx__ctx_s<seed>.parquet, ranking), refit12 (Jan-Dec; ranking), run in that order per seed by tools/ctx_chain.sh

declaration.purpose: Round D (the CPU filler the user approved with Round C): 16 more seeds (133-148) of round A's ctx_e24 network, unchanged, as ens_ctx_e24b; does a larger e24 pool improve v28's committee mix? Declared before any fit of these seeds.
declaration.selection: A candidate is eligible when: no recipe month is worse on ALL rows (ratio to the control <= 1.0); the mean ratio over the four recipe months is at least 0.02% below 1; and on every month where it changes a row the paired-day bootstrap 95% interval of the RMSE difference against the control lies below zero. Among eligible candidates choose the lowest mean ratio (ties by name); otherwise select nothing and keep v27. The rule of adsb_nn/nn2, unchanged.
declaration.ship: If a candidate is selected: the coverage-regime ship check (the gate of configs/adsb_ctx_regime_check_v1.json, both thinned months) against v28; ranking tables from the refit12 seed means; v28 rebuilt from its export detail must reproduce the uploaded v28 exactly; export, independent verification, audit, upload only with the user's approval.
